messages:
rachel: Quick sync — I want to land the tenant-routing flag rollout docs by EOD. Need agreement on telemetry gates + kill-switch choreography before shiproom tomorrow. :eyes:
omar: Thanks — are we doing staged-regions or per-tenant slices for the first wave? Customer asks want EU-first.
kevin: Proposing staged regions: EU (5% traffic) -> NA (10%) -> global. Canary will run 30m per slice. Auto-rollback if error_rate > 1.5x baseline for 5m.
claire: SRE + alerting: agree on rollback threshold but need a secondary guard: sustained tail latency > 95th baseline + increase in 5xxs. If both trigger within 10m, auto kill.
ben: +1 for the dual-trigger. Also request a manual override path for customer ops. Document the runbook steps and the flag name.
rachel: Flag name: `feature:tenant-routing/v2`. Canary plan snippet: 
```
- EU: 5% traffic, 30m
- NA: 10% traffic, 30m
- AB test (optional): 50/50 subset for paying customers
- Rollback: auto if (error_rate >= 1.5x && tail_latency >= +20%) within 10m OR error_rate >= 3x immediate
```
kevin: Implementation notes: we'll add a soft-fail path to route to legacy routing stack and increment metric `routing.fallback_count`. Also add a sampling span tag `routing.variant` for traces.
claire: Monitoring: add these alerts
- `routing.error_rate` > 1.2x baseline for 5m (warn)
- `routing.error_rate` >= 1.5x baseline for 5m (crit, triggers auto-rollback)
- `routing.95th_latency` +20% for 10m (crit)
We will also add a pager policy to oncall + product on critical.
omar: Launch criteria checklist (pre-shiproom):
- [ ] Runbook linked and reviewed by SRE
- [ ] Customer ops override documented
- [ ] Telemetry dashboards created (error_rate, lat_p95, fallback_count)
- [ ] Canary automation tested in staging
- [ ] Legal/Privacy signoff for EU routing
rachel: I'm going to fill those and ping owners. Ben can you draft the customer ops override text?
ben: On it — will attach a one-page flow and the exact Slack escalations.
sre-bot: Scheduled canary job created: job_id=canary-1753210000-eu. Notifying oncall in 10m.
kevin: One more ask — add a flag to disable the AB test branch independently, just in case. `feature:tenant-routing/v2.ab_optout`
claire: LGTM. If no objections, I’ll sign-off on the runbook and create the dashboards after lunch.
omar: No objections from me. Thanks team — we’ll present the plan in shiproom with the checklist.%
